prompts.title: Generate CSC KPI for Work Effort
prompts.prompt: Review the Desired Outcomes and Project Objectives, then propose CSC, KPI, KPI value type, and KPI target date for this work effort.
prompts.description: As a Project Manager, review the Desired Outcome(s) and Project Objective(s) to generate CSC, KPI, KPI Value Type, and KPI Target Date for the work effort. Use this prompt to structure measurable items that can be tracked throughout the project lifecycle.
prompts.author: Rathinam, Archana [TECH]
prompts.tip: Ensure the Project Description and Project Objective are clear and concise for effective output.

prompts.title: Review CSC KPI and Refine Project Description for Projects
prompts.prompt: Given an existing project description and KPIs, identify gaps and suggest refined wording.
prompts.description: CSC is Critical Success Criteria; this prompt helps validate measurable success terms.
prompts.author: Rathinam, Archana [TECH]

subtitle: Automates release pipelines, version management, and deployment artifacts.

prompts.title: Write User Story from Feature Brief
prompts.prompt: From this feature brief and acceptance criteria, draft a user story.
prompts.description: Generate a user story and acceptance criteria from a feature brief.
prompts.author: Sarah Chen [PROD]

prompts.title: Refine Backlog and Prioritize by Value
prompts.prompt: Review this backlog and prioritize based on value, dependencies, and risk.
prompts.description: Suggest a priority order for backlog items with a short rationale.
prompts.author: David Park [PROD]

prompts.title: Rollback Runbook from Release Notes
prompts.prompt: From release notes and deployment steps, create a rollback runbook.
prompts.description: Generate a rollback runbook with pre-conditions, steps, and checks.
prompts.author: Ops Team [INFRA]

prompts.title: Incident Summary for Post-Mortem
prompts.prompt: Using incident information, draft a post-mortem summary.
prompts.description: Draft a blameless incident summary with timeline and follow-up actions.
prompts.author: Ops Team [INFRA]

prompts.title: Generate Implementation Plan from Ticket
prompts.prompt: From this ticket, propose implementation plan, tests, and rollout steps.
prompts.description: Generate an implementation plan from a Jira ticket or feature request.
prompts.author: Devin AI Team

prompts.title: Draft Initial Incident Bridge Announcement
prompts.prompt: From these incident details, draft a concise bridge announcement.
prompts.description: Draft an incident bridge announcement with impact and next update time.
prompts.author: Incident Mgmt [OPS]
